title: The Day Whitey Basson Told Shoprite's Shareholders He Was Tired

His stake (1.6% worth R1.77bn vs about 1.5% bought back for R1.75bn) - story uses the buy-back figures. Reason for retiring (tiredness vs analysts' view of the Steinhoff merger; both men denied the deal was the reason) - all three given.
notes: Episode changed from the slate's 1979 purchase, which is documented only in outline (no Basson account of the decision; Shoprite's profile page blocks automated requests), to his well-documented 2016 retirement, with the 1979 purchase as background.
